content:
🎉 I’m thrilled to share that I’ve joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I’ve seen firsthand how it empowers smarter, more connected clinical workflows—and I’m excited to help move the standard forward as part of the committee.

If your organization is already using CDS Hooks, please consider adding your implementation to our open directory: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability). Sharing your use case not only helps the community but also drives the standard’s evolution.

If you’re thinking about adopting CDS Hooks and need guidance, I’m available as a freelance consultant to help you get started or optimize your implementation. Let’s unlock the power of open clinical decision support together!

#CDSHooks #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #HealthIT #FHIR
